description: After an attempt to fix a failing test: done, retry or escalate. State: {test, last}.

next.instructions: An attempt to fix a failing test ran the tests again. What should happen next?

criteria.done: the tests pass: the fix is finished
criteria.retry: the tests still fail, and another attempt could fix them
criteria.escalate: the tests still fail, and more attempts will not help: a person must look
